model_name.notes: Discrete-time stochastic population model with complete demography

version.notes: Added robust outputs, fertility tables, life tables, and population adjustments

author.notes: Academic use - inspired by STDSIM framework

step_size.notes: Number of units per timestep (12 months = 1 year timestep)

terminal_summary.notes: Print summary to terminal at end of simulation

summary_years.notes: Which years to include in terminal summary

quantiles.notes: Quantiles for aggregated outputs (median and 90% interval)

initial_hiv_prevalence.notes: Proportion of initial population with chronic HIV (to seed epidemic)

initial_distribution.notes: Initial population by orientation → age group → sexual activity level

enabled.notes: If false, no demographic changes except aging and mortality

annual_entrants.notes: Number of new entrants per year (only used if mode='fixed_net_addition')

entry_age_group.notes: Which age group receives new entrants

background_mortality.notes: Annual non-HIV death rate (used if life_table not enabled)

enabled.notes: If true, override background mortality with life-table survival probabilities

source_notes.value: Example life table - replace with actual data for your population
source_notes.notes: Citation for life table data source

survival_by_age_limit.notes: Piecewise survival probabilities up to each age_limit (probability of surviving from birth to that age)

enabled.notes: Enable births via age-specific fertility rates (ASFR)

entry_age_group.notes: Age group where newborns enter (representing sexual debut)

newborn_activity_distribution.notes: How newborns are distributed across sexual activity groups

asfr_by_age_limit.notes: Births per woman-year, piecewise by age band (age-specific fertility rates)

enabled.notes: If true, apply year-specific multipliers to baseline ASFR

values.notes: Fertility multipliers by calendar year (interpolated between years)

enabled.notes: If true, apply exogenous multipliers to population totals over time (for calibration)

value.name: MSM
value.notes: Men who have sex with men

orientations.notes: Sexual orientation groups - order matters for mixing

age_groups.notes: Age groups in 5-year bins. Can be modified freely.

sexual_activity_groups.notes: Sexual activity levels. contact_rate = acts per year (combined with per-act beta for transmission). Number of groups and rates are fully configurable.

hiv_stages.notes: HIV disease stages - DO NOT MODIFY ORDER

heterosexual.notes: Mixing matrix for heterosexual contacts (Female ↔ Heterosexual_Male). Rows must sum to 1.0.

msm.notes: Mixing matrix for MSM contacts. Rows must sum to 1.0.

condom_usage.notes: Condom risk multiplier by activity group. Applied as: effective_beta = beta * condom_mod. Values: 1.0 = no condom effect (baseline), 0.5 = 50% risk reduction. Lower = more protection.

beta_acute.notes: Per-act transmission probability during acute infection

beta_chronic.notes: Per-act transmission probability during chronic infection

beta_aids.notes: Per-act transmission probability during AIDS stage

acute_to_chronic.notes: Annual probability of progressing from acute to chronic HIV

chronic_to_aids.notes: Annual probability of progressing from chronic to AIDS

annual_rate.notes: Annual probability of HIV diagnosis (if undiagnosed)

art_initiation_rate.notes: Annual probability of starting ART (if diagnosed but not on treatment)

art_dropout_rate.notes: Annual probability of discontinuing ART (if on treatment)

art_transmission_reduction.notes: Reduction in transmission probability when on ART (96% = U=U)

art_mortality_reduction.notes: Reduction in HIV mortality when on ART (90% reduction)

acute.notes: Annual HIV mortality during acute stage

chronic.notes: Annual HIV mortality during chronic stage

aids.notes: Annual HIV mortality during AIDS stage

combine_with_background.notes: 'excess' (HIV mortality added to background) or 'override' (HIV mortality replaces background)

enabled.notes: Whether this intervention is active in the simulation

efficacy.notes: Protection per dosing cycle (86% effectiveness with adherence)

uptake_rate.notes: Annual probability of starting PrEP (susceptible only)

uptake_modifier_by_activity.notes: Multiplier for uptake rate by activity level

enabled.notes: Whether this intervention is active in the simulation

efficacy.notes: Protection per dosing cycle (99% from PURPOSE trials)

uptake_modifier_by_activity.notes: Multiplier for uptake rate by activity level

n_runs.notes: Number of stochastic simulation runs (use 100+ for uncertainty analysis)

seed.notes: Base random number generator seed for reproducibility

deterministic_mode.notes: If true, replace random draws with expected values (for debugging/testing)

notes.calibration_status: Example configuration - replace with calibrated parameters
notes.intended_use: Thesis research on HIV prevention interventions
notes.academic_framing: This model is inspired by STDSIM's conceptual framework but reimplemented as a discrete-time stochastic population model to enable flexible stratification of sexual behavior and modern PrEP interventions.
